### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in both files are aimed at fixing Sphinx warnings related to the `raw` directive. In `pixfmt-packed-rgb.rst`, the removal of the empty `raw` directive prevents the warning about a missing content block. In `dev-sliced-vbi.rst`, the addition of blank lines after the `raw` directives ensures that the documentation is correctly formatted, allowing Sphinx to process it without errors. Both changes contribute to improving the overall documentation quality and ensuring successful builds without warnings.
